scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:visual: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check:preview-import-routing && pnpm run setup:playwright && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$PWD/.cache/ms-playwright" playwright test
scripts.test:folder-import-integration: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test:folder-import-integration
scripts.test:release: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run test && pnpm run test:client-access-recovery && pnpm run test:bundle-size
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
